'''Shade Ridge''' is a mountain and area in the southeast part of [[Jinzhou]].

[[Jinzhou]] is the most recent city established in [[Huanglong]]. Situated on the northern border of Huanglong, nestled within the expanse of a great lake, embraced by waters on three sides and cradled by mountains on the fourth. Shade Ridge is one of these mountains.
